description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for loading and processing CFF glyphs in the FreeType project, specifically related to the OpenType glyph loader and glyph outline building.

classes.name: CFF_Builder
classes.description: Structure used during glyph loading to store outline and related parameters.

classes.name: CFF_Decoder
classes.description: Structure representing the execution context for decoding CFF charstrings, including glyph and font data, stacks, zones, and hinting information.

classes.name: CFF_Decoder_Zone
classes.description: Structure representing a zone in the decoder's charstring execution context with base, limit, and cursor pointers.

methods.name: cff_check_points
methods.description: Checks if the builder has enough points for a given count.

methods.name: cff_builder_add_point
methods.description: Adds a point with coordinates and a flag to the glyph outline being built.

methods.name: cff_builder_add_point1
methods.description: Adds a point with coordinates to the glyph outline.

methods.name: cff_builder_start_point
methods.description: Starts a new point at given coordinates in the glyph outline.

methods.name: cff_builder_close_contour
methods.description: Closes the current contour in the glyph outline.

methods.name: cff_lookup_glyph_by_stdcharcode
methods.description: Looks up a glyph index by standard character code.

methods.name: cff_get_glyph_data
methods.description: Retrieves glyph data for a given glyph index.

methods.name: cff_decoder_init
methods.description: Initializes a CFF_Decoder structure with font and glyph information.

methods.name: cff_decoder_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the decoder for decoding a specific glyph.

methods.name: cff_slot_load
methods.description: Loads a glyph into a glyph slot with specified size and load flags.
